screen.superbcamera.editor.title: Camera Editor
screen.superbcamera.name: Click to rename. Enter confirms, Esc reverts.
screen.superbcamera.add.tooltip: Add a copy of this camera as a new entry in the F5 cycle and switch to it.
screen.superbcamera.add.full: The limit of %s perspectives is reached. Delete one to add another.
screen.superbcamera.delete.tooltip: Delete this perspective from the F5 cycle.
screen.superbcamera.tab.transform.toolti: Transform: location and rotation relative to the anchor.
screen.superbcamera.tab.lens.tooltip: Field of view, smoothing and HUD.
screen.superbcamera.tab.anchor.tooltip: What the camera is attached to, and how it follows it.
screen.superbcamera.tab.targets.tooltip: Pick an entity or vehicle to follow.
screen.superbcamera.pos.x.tooltip: Sideways offset in blocks. Positive moves the camera to the right of the anchor. Drag to scrub, click to type, wheel to nudge.
screen.superbcamera.pos.y.tooltip: Vertical offset in blocks. Positive moves the camera up.
screen.superbcamera.pos.z.tooltip: Offset along the anchor heading in blocks. Negative is behind it.
screen.superbcamera.rot.yaw.tooltip: Turns the camera left (negative) or right (positive) relative to the anchor.
screen.superbcamera.rot.pitch.tooltip: Tilts the camera down (positive) or up (negative).
screen.superbcamera.rot.roll.tooltip: Rolls the camera clockwise (positive) or counter-clockwise (negative).
screen.superbcamera.fov.tooltip: Field of view in degrees while this perspective is active.
screen.superbcamera.smoothing.tooltip: 0 locks the camera exactly. Higher values make it lag behind the anchor.
screen.superbcamera.hide_hud.tooltip: Hides the HUD (including Superb Warfare overlays) while this camera is active and the editor is closed. F1 is not affected.
screen.superbcamera.anchor.vehicle.toolt: Attach to the vehicle you ride (full pitch and roll with Superb Warfare). Falls back to the player on foot.
screen.superbcamera.anchor.player.toolti: Attach to yourself (or the spectated entity), turning with the body only.
screen.superbcamera.anchor.world.tooltip: A fixed spot in the world, for fly-by shots. The first time it captures the current view.
screen.superbcamera.anchor.target.toolti: Follow the entity picked in the Targets tab.
screen.superbcamera.anchor.target.locked: Pick an entity in the Targets tab first.
screen.superbcamera.lock.tooltip: On: the view turns with the anchor (pitch and roll too, for vehicles). Off: the view follows where you look, plus the offsets.
screen.superbcamera.inherit_pitch.toolti: Follow the nose of the anchor up and down. Only used when locked to a vehicle or target.
screen.superbcamera.inherit_roll.tooltip: Follow the bank angle of the anchor. Turn off for a level horizon.
screen.superbcamera.reacquire.tooltip: When the target disappears, follow the nearest loaded entity of the same type (for example a boss that respawned).
screen.superbcamera.world_here.tooltip: Stores the current camera position and direction as the fixed spot and clears the offsets.
screen.superbcamera.targets.sort.name: Name
screen.superbcamera.targets.hint: Far targets need spectator mode + cheats
screen.superbcamera.emulate.tooltip: Alt + left drag orbits, Alt+Shift pans, Alt+Ctrl dollies. Turn off if your mouse has a comfortable middle button.
screen.superbcamera.keys.wheel: Dolly toward / away from the pivot
screen.superbcamera.keys.emulation: Orbit (Shift: pan, Ctrl: dolly) when 3-button emulation is on
screen.superbcamera.keys.grab: Move the camera. X / Y / Z constrain (again: camera axis), type a value, Enter / LMB confirm, Esc / RMB cancel
screen.superbcamera.keys.rotate: Rotate. X pitch, Y yaw, Z roll, type degrees, Shift fine, Ctrl snap
screen.superbcamera.keys.views: Front / Right / Top view (Ctrl: back / left / bottom). Also 1 / 3 / 7
screen.superbcamera.keys.frame: Aim at the pivot, keep the position
screen.superbcamera.keys.fly: Fly mode. WASD move, Q / E down / up, wheel speed, Shift fast, Alt slow, LMB / Enter confirm, Esc cancel
screen.superbcamera.reset.tooltip: Restores the settings of this perspective to the defaults. The name is kept.
screen.superbcamera.exit.tooltip: Stops the custom camera and returns to the normal third person view. Perspectives stay saved.
screen.superbcamera.side: Move the panel to the other side of the screen
screen.superbcamera.done.tooltip: Close the editor. The camera stays locked on this perspective.
screen.superbcamera.size.large.tooltip: Panel as large as the GUI scale of the game.
overlay.superbcamera.hint: MMB orbit · Shift+MMB pan · Wheel zoom · G move · R rotate · N panel
overlay.superbcamera.modal_hint: [X/Y/Z] constrain  [0-9 . -] type  [Enter / LMB] confirm  [Esc / RMB] cancel
overlay.superbcamera.fly: Fly  %s m/s   [WASD] move  [Q/E] down / up  [Wheel] speed  [Shift] fast  [Alt] slow  [LMB / Enter] confirm  [Esc / RMB] cancel
message.superbcamera.dimension: Superb Camera: the world spot of "%s" is in another dimension, following the player instead.
